text:
Sara (PR): Heads-up — finalizing press + analyst briefings for the launch. embargo window = Wed 03/25 08:00 PT. Need to lock EU/APAC briefing times and a final quote by EOD tomorrow.
Michael (Product): Can we do two analyst slots? EMEA morning (09:30–10:00 GMT) and APAC late afternoon (16:30–17:00 SGT).
Dina (PR Ops): EMEA slot OK for analyst A, but APAC 16:30 conflicts with partner webinar. alternative: 15:00 SGT?
Alex (Sales): I'd prefer a combined analyst+press 30m in EMEA and keep APAC as a 1:1 analyst slot.
Sara (PR): OK propose: EMEA 09:30 GMT (30m), APAC 15:00 SGT (30m). Who can take APAC? @Michael?
Michael (Product): I can do APAC. Need approved quote text and the exact benchmark callouts — p95 latency + cost per 1k tokens?
Dina (PR Ops): We can share p50/p95 latency and a cost-per-1k-inference-tokens estimate. Legal flagged the phrasing around 'tokens' — prefer 'per 1k inference tokens'.
Tom (Data): For bench transparency, reference run config: internal-bench-v2, seq=512, batch=8, amp=true. raw logs at https://internal.redwood/bench/launch-2026 
Sara (PR): Draft quote — please approve/edit by 10am tomorrow or we'll use the safe fallback.
Sara (PR): ```"Redwood Inference delivers enterprise-grade inference with sub-50ms p95 latency on common LLM workloads and predictable unit economics for production deployments."```
Michael (Product): Can we soften to 'sub-60ms p95'? Tom, does that align with our aggregated p95?
Tom (Data): 'sub-60ms p95' is conservative and supported across eu-central + us-west from verified runs with seq=512.
Dina (PR Ops): @Legal — quick check: ok to send the run config link to press + analysts and keep the csv? also confirm 'enterprise-grade' wording.
Legal (LegalBot): Remove or define 'enterprise-grade'. Also ensure any customer examples are redacted. Approve sharing run config and anonymized csv.
Sara (PR): Revised draft: "Redwood Inference delivers sub-60ms p95 latency on representative LLM workloads and predictable unit economics for production deployments."
Alex (Sales): :thumbsup: from me.
calendar-bot: created EMEA slot 2026-03-25 09:30 GMT — invite sent. APAC tentative 2026-03-25 15:00 SGT (pending confirmations).
Sara (PR): Fact-check package link for press/analysts: https://redwoodhq.sharepoint.com/launch/factcheck — includes run config, methodology note, and raw p95 distributions. Deadline for external fact-check: EOD tomorrow.
Michael (Product): I'll upload run logs + short methodology note by 09:00 tomorrow.
Tom (Data): I'll add raw p95 distributions and the csv (anonymized).
Dina (PR Ops): Reminder: final quote sign-off cutoff 10:00 tomorrow PT. If no reply, we'll publish the revised draft.
Sara (PR): Thanks team — if no objections by EOD we'll lock embargo, finalize invites, and start outreach to press & analysts. :rocket:
